name: Hunger Magazine
introduction: Each other is a contemporary Paris based fashion brand that promotes its sensual architectural wardrobe for women. Born of an encounter between the two founders and creative directors - fashion designer Ilan Delouis and art director & gallerist Jenny Mannerheim. Their complementary universes and visions fuse roughness and sensuality, timeless pieces and experimental design. The style of Each Other encompasses the founders passion for the architecture of John Lautner, the minimalism art movement associated with sculptures by Donald Judd and light artworks by Dan Flavin. Focusing on tailoring, the timeless ‘vestiaire’ and noble fabrics, the brand reinterprets statement wardrobe pieces that are re-sculpted and composed into a singular feminine silhouette. The brand also acts as a label and media for artists and creative talents to collaborate on limited edition fashion items that keep up the pulse of the collections through the seasons.  Hunger Magazine is a fast evolving and expanding biannual lifestyle, fashion, music and art magazine from photographer and publisher, Rankin. Constantly widening its reach, the magazine is continuing to collaborate with the best of photographers, stylists and creative minds and have an extensive and active social media network to engage and interact with its readers. However, the publication remains the same at its core: fascinated by people, fashion, music and art.
